name: viva-prep-pack
description: Prepare a doctoral candidate for the viva or thesis defence with a written pack: a three-minute thesis summary, the contribution stated plainly, predicted questions by chapter with answer outlines, the weak points and how to own them, a chapter-by-chapter crib sheet, and a plan for the final two weeks. Use when asked to prepare for my viva, what will my examiners ask, help me summarise my thesis, I am worried about my methods chapter in the defence, or make a viva revision plan. Produces the pack as a document to study from. Distinct from the-thesis-defense, which runs a live mock defence; use this first, then that.
